record.hypothesis: Across all four datasets, replace GELU with SiLU in the existing Transformer feed-forward sublayers. Its smoother negative response may improve masked-item representations without the capacity increase that regressed when feed-forward width doubled. Preserve bidirectional attention, two pre-norm blocks, intermediate width, residual paths, features, embeddings, readout, loss and optimizer. Apply the same activation in the predictor-loaded architecture.

category_rationales.rationale: Replace GELU with SiLU in the existing Transformer feed-forward sublayers across all four category models. Preserve widths, bidirectional attention, residual paths, embeddings, readout, loss and optimizer. The generated predictor imports BERT4RecModel from train.py, so it automatically uses the same activation with unchanged checkpoint shapes.
